card.name: UN agency names and official titles
card.fires_on: Words in and around United Nations agency names (UNICEF, ILO, WHO, UNEP, FAO), especially just before an agency's office or official title, or inside the agency name itself.

modes.label: Inside agency names
modes.description: Last letters or pieces of UN agency acronyms such as UNICEF or ILO.

modes.label: Before agency role or office
modes.description: Small linking words or punctuation after a speaker's name or title, right before an agency's office or department.
modes.example: says Dr Etienne Krug, WHO Director<< of>> the Department of Violence and Injury Prevention

modes.label: Agency web addresses
modes.description: Punctuation in a link to a UN agency site.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming UN bodies such as UN, WHO and UNESCO.
card.plain: It lights up in press-release text where a UN agency or its officials are being named or quoted.
